description: This Java class configures security settings for a Spring Boot application using Spring Security. It sets up authentication providers, password encoding, JWT-based authentication filters, CORS configuration, and web security rules.

classes.name: SecurityConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring Security configuration class that sets up authentication, authorization, CORS, JWT filters, and web security rules.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Defines a bean for password encoding using BCryptPasswordEncoder.

methods.name: configure(AuthenticationManagerBuilder auth)
methods.description: Configures the authentication manager with a custom authentication provider and user details service.

methods.name: authenticationProviderBean
methods.description: Creates and exposes a custom AuthenticationProvider bean used for authentication.

methods.name: authenticationManagerBean
methods.description: Exposes the AuthenticationManager as a bean for dependency injection.

methods.name: configure(WebSecurity web)
methods.description: Configures web security to ignore static resources and certain endpoints.

methods.name: configure(HttpSecurity http)
methods.description: Sets up HTTP security with CORS, CSRF disablement, JWT filters, session management, and request authorization rules.

methods.name: corsConfigurationSource()
methods.description: Defines a CORS configuration source allowing specific origins, methods, headers, and credentials.
